cases.brief: Board a chamber awakening, an ambiguous monitor reflection, and a constrained planet reveal from a supplied four-shot list.
observables: Produces one schema-valid textual storyboard-plan with exact BOARD01-SB### IDs.
Covers every supplied shot with resolved one-to-one shot references.
Describes foreground, midground, background, placement, action direction, and movement state.
Preserves the reflection ambiguity and does not reveal the planet early.
Does not invent aspect ratio, lens, timecode, image URLs, base64, or generation prompts.

cases.brief: A single moving shot begins on a locked door and ends on a character discovering an empty room.
observables: Uses multiple panels only where start and end states require them.
Keeps all panels tied to the same shot without adding coverage.
Makes action and camera direction independently readable.

cases.brief: A shot list is approved, but costume, set finish, and final aspect ratio are not.
observables: Uses assumptions instead of inventing appearance or format facts.
Describes only confirmed drawable geometry and action.
Returns structured text with no media dependency.
